description: Pier / boardwalk cell at golden hour (goal.md AD-2): the ocean, seagulls, a DJ booth. Marble text prompt (+ key art once approved) → spz 100k/500k/full + collider + pano + cell.json.

inputs.text: Standing in the middle of a weathered wooden pier and boardwalk on the Northern California coast at golden hour. Low sun over the Pacific, long shadows across sun-bleached planks, railings with peeling paint, old sodium lamps just switching on, a small wooden DJ booth with speakers and a string of festival lights near the end of the pier, a shuttered bait shop, benches, seagulls perched on the posts, fog rolling in over the water, coastal hills in the distance. Photorealistic, physically plausible light, melancholy and beautiful West Coast dusk. No people, no cars.
